scope: Current rolling homepage termWindow, beginning Frost Descent 2026; includes three full forward year cycles and both boundary fragments. Counts are the actual public canonical ingredient families used by rankSeasonFoods / seasonFoodsFor, not the raw source observation audit.
findings: plan keeps every candidate absent from the previous selected list, then at most the same number of repeats; a large selected list makes the next term lose many candidates and causes alternating large/small lists.
The next iteration compares with the already trimmed previous list, so after a small list the following term gains many apparently fresh choices, amplifying oscillation.
The first term compares with the full untrimmed previous pool, while subsequent terms compare with curated lists; boundary position explains same-term changes across rolling calendars.
Photo availability removes additional eligible all-season choices before the curated plan. This is separate from missing actual sourced seasonal foods.

recommended.description: Cap at 18 only when the original selected list is longer. Rank fresh candidates with the featured choice first, take up to 9 fresh plus at most the same number of repeats (also feature first), then fill unused places with further fresh choices. Preserve sourced pools, original output order and the quarter-specific hairtail rule.

testImplications: Add a regression for large preceding pool followed by a scarce pool; assert min/max and max adjacent gap on actual rolling 3-year homepage selections.
For each selected list assert sourced-pool subset, no family duplicate, feature kept when available and repeated-current-total <= 0.5 except existing fully-repeated fallback.
Assert source data and raw month/term windows remain unchanged.
Existing full-catalog audit-term-repetition tests need no semantic change for this selection-only update; new records independently affect their count snapshots.
Existing focused season-selection unit tests and annual homepage integration tests should remain valid. No expectation for a uniform fixed number should be introduced.

evaluatedLookaheadAlternative.description: Retain exact sourced pools and hairtail-quarter rule. Rank both fresh and repeated candidates with featured ingredient first, then prefer ingredients not also eligible next term; preserve original order for ties. Reserve up to half of 20 places for fresh and at most the same count of repeats, then fill remaining places with further fresh candidates. Keep existing fallback for a wholly repeated pool. Filter results back through original pool order.
